## Findings
- claim-1: \(I_{5,4}\) is the Schur-span outside \((4^5)\), and \(A=\Lambda/I_{5,4}\) has basis \(\{\bar s_\lambda:\lambda\subseteq(4^5)\}\). [source-2@L1318-L1331|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: For the \(5\)-Grassmannian bigrassmannian with rectangular shape \(i^j\), \(J_v\) is generated in \(\Lambda/I_{5,4}\) by \(\{\,\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(4^5)\,\}\). [source-2@L1354-L1374|claim=formal-document]
- claim-3: For \(i=j=2,\ p=2,\ c=3\), hence \(q=i+p=4,\ r=j+c=5\), one has \[ J_{2,3}=\bigoplus_{(2,2)\subseteq\lambda\subseteq(4^5)} \mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda . \]
- claim-4: In \(A=\Lambda/I_{5,4}\), \[ A_+=(\bar h_1,\bar h_2,\bar h_3,\bar h_4). \]
- claim-5: For every degree \(e\), all rows \[ \bar h_t\bar s_\lambda =\sum_{\substack{\lambda\subseteq\nu\subseteq(4^5)\\ \nu/\lambda\text{ a horizontal }t\text{-strip}}}\bar s_\nu, \qquad 1\le t\le4,\quad (2,2)\subseteq\lambda,\quad |\lambda|=e-t, \] are exactly the complete degree-\(e\) presentation of \((A_+J_{2,3})_e\).
## Strategy
Let \(A=\Lambda/I_{5,4}\). By `claim-1`,
\[
A=\bigoplus_{\lambda\subseteq(4^5)}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda .
\]
By `claim-2`, \(J_{2,3}\) is generated by all \(\bar s_\mu\) with
\[
(2,2)\subseteq\mu\subseteq(4^5).
\]
Their span is an ideal: Littlewood--Richardson containment
\(c_{\mu,\rho}^{\nu}\ne0\Rightarrow\mu\subseteq\nu\) ensures that multiplication preserves containment of \((2,2)\), while terms outside \((4^5)\) vanish in \(A\). Therefore
\[
J_{2,3}=\bigoplus_{(2,2)\subseteq\lambda\subseteq(4^5)}
\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda .
\]

Since \(\Lambda=\mathbb Z[h_1,h_2,\ldots]\) and \(\bar h_t=\bar s_{(t)}=0\) for \(t\ge5\), \(A\) is generated by \(\bar h_1,\ldots,\bar h_4\). Hence
\[
A_+=(\bar h_1,\bar h_2,\bar h_3,\bar h_4).
\]

Writing
\[
(J_{2,3})_d=
\bigoplus_{\substack{(2,2)\subseteq\lambda\subseteq(4^5)\\|\lambda|=d}}
\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda ,
\]
which is zero unless \(4\le d\le20\), one has in every integer degree \(e\)
\[
(A_+J_{2,3})_e=\sum_{t=1}^{4}\bar h_t(J_{2,3})_{e-t}.
\]
For every basis source \(\lambda\) of degree \(e-t\), the corresponding complete row is
\[
\bar h_t\bar s_\lambda
=
\sum_{\substack{\lambda\subseteq\nu\subseteq(4^5)\\
\nu/\lambda\text{ a horizontal }t\text{-strip}}}\bar s_\nu .
\]
If \(e-t\notin[4,20]\), there is no source row; strips leaving \((4^5)\) vanish. Thus precisely these rows, for \(1\le t\le4\), present the full degree-\(e\) lattice \((A_+J_{2,3})_e\).

## Gaps
None for this bounded certificate. No Smith-form or quotient computation is required for the stated presentation equality.

## Next
This establishes only \(i=j=p=2,\ c=3\); it gives no parent-theorem or uniform-parameter conclusion.
